## Template Used

LACDR-ISA - Assay (General) v1.0.0

## Title

`r rmarkdown::metadata$title`

## Date (dd-MM-yyyy)

`r format(Sys.time(), format = "%d-%m-%Y")`

## Description or Purpose

Build Figure 3

### Background

### Data sources

-   Loadings and weights for Factor 1 from Figure 1
-   Gene expression from Koedoot et al. (PMID:33790333)
-   Metadata from Leegwater et al. (PMID: 40763903)
-   Patient gene expression data from TCGA
-   Workflow created in drawio
-   Pathway and gene mappings from Reactome (Ensmbl2Reactome.txt). The source is:

Reactome, from https://reactome.org/download-data downloaded on 20-01-2025

And the Zenodo release v91 from Dec 2024 https://zenodo.org/records/14518331 downloaded on 20-01-2025 I also use the same all_transport_pathway_genes.csv as in Figure 2.

### Analysis plan

-   A: Workflow on how we selected genes
-   B-E: Differentially expressed metabolic genes in cell lines

#### Length of metabolic gene lists

##### Gene ontology

```{r}
columns(org.Hs.eg.db)
```

Get genes associated with gene ontology <GO:0008152> metabolic process [link](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO:0008152).

```{r}
columns(org.Hs.eg.db)
get_gene_symbols_GO <- function(GO_term) {
  column_names <- c("SYMBOL", "ENSEMBL", "ENTREZID", "GENENAME")
  gene_symbols <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys = GO_term,
    columns = column_names,
    keytype = "GOALL"
  ) |>
    dplyr::select(-EVIDENCEALL) |>
    distinct() |>
    arrange(SYMBOL) |>
    dplyr::rename(gene_symbol = SYMBOL)
  print(str_glue("{GO_term} has {nrow(gene_symbols)} rows and {length(unique(gene_symbols$gene_symbol))} unique gene symbols"))
  return(gene_symbols)
}
```

```{r}
GO_metabolic_genes <- get_gene_symbols_GO("GO:0008152")

write_csv(
  GO_metabolic_genes,
  here(output_dir, "metabolic_process_GO.0008152.csv")
)
```

##### KEGG

Following tutorial [KEGGREST](https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/vignettes/KEGGREST/inst/doc/KEGGREST-vignette.html)

```{r}
# Get the human metabolism for kegg & extract all pathways
human_metabolism_map <- keggGet("hsa01100")
human_metabolism_map[[1]]$NAME
related_pathways <- names(human_metabolism_map[[1]]$REL_PATHWAY)
head(related_pathways)

# Get all genes from pathways
pathways_from_KEGG <- list()
for (nr in 1:length(related_pathways)) {
  pathway_info <- keggGet(related_pathways[nr])
  pathways_from_KEGG[[pathway_info[[1]]$ENTRY]] <- pathway_info[[1]]$GENE
}

# The gene column has even numbers for gene symbols and odd numbers for matching entrez identifiers.
# Extract per pathway and merge into one data frame
KEGG_metabolic_genes <- map_dfr(names(pathways_from_KEGG), function(pathway_name) {
  pathway <- pathways_from_KEGG[[pathway_name]]
  res <- data.frame(
    pathway_name = pathway_name,
    entrez_ID = pathway[seq(1, length(pathway), by = 2)],
    gene_symbol = pathway[seq(2, length(pathway), by = 2)]
  )
  return(res)
}) |>
  # Split the gene symbol column into gene symbol and gene name
  separate(gene_symbol, into = c("gene_symbol", "gene_name"), sep = ";", remove = TRUE)

dim(KEGG_metabolic_genes)
head(KEGG_metabolic_genes)

# Quality control: Check one that is missing a gene symbol.
# This indeed matches a non-gene: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/107984365
KEGG_metabolic_genes[468, ]

write_csv(KEGG_metabolic_genes, here(output_dir, "KEGG_metabolic_genes_hsa01100.csv"))
```

##### Descriptive statistics for the manuscript

Number of gene symbols in each list

```{r}
extract_gene_symbols <- function(df) {
  df |>
    filter(!is.na(gene_symbol)) |>
    pull(gene_symbol) |>
    unique()
}
count_unique_genes <- function(df) {
  df |>
    extract_gene_symbols() |>
    length()
}
count_unique_genes(KEGG_metabolic_genes)
count_unique_genes(GO_metabolic_genes)
count_unique_genes(Recon3D_genes)
count_unique_genes(Reactome_metabolic_genes)
```

Prepare for supplementary Upset plot?

```{r}
count_overlapping_genes <- function(df1, df2, df3 = NULL, df4 = NULL) {
  nr_overlaps <- intersect(extract_gene_symbols(df1), extract_gene_symbols(df2)) |>
    length()
  if (!is.null(df3) && !is.null(df4)) {
    nr_overlaps <- intersect(
      intersect(extract_gene_symbols(df1), extract_gene_symbols(df2)),
      intersect(extract_gene_symbols(df3), extract_gene_symbols(df4))
    ) |>
      length()
  }
  return(nr_overlaps)
}
# pairwise overlaps
count_overlapping_genes(KEGG_metabolic_genes, GO_metabolic_genes)
count_overlapping_genes(KEGG_metabolic_genes, Recon3D_genes)
count_overlapping_genes(GO_metabolic_genes, Recon3D_genes)
count_overlapping_genes(KEGG_metabolic_genes, Reactome_metabolic_genes)
count_overlapping_genes(GO_metabolic_genes, Reactome_metabolic_genes)
count_overlapping_genes(Recon3D_genes, Reactome_metabolic_genes)

# all overlaps
count_overlapping_genes(KEGG_metabolic_genes, GO_metabolic_genes, Recon3D_genes, Reactome_metabolic_genes)
```

344967 is a pseudogene: [LOC344967 acyl-CoA thioesterase 7 pseudogene](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/344967) 102724197 also refers to a locus/inactive gene: [LOC102724197 inactive glutathione hydrolase 2](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/102724197) I decided that it is okay to not include these.

### Filtering steps for differential expression analysis

#### Load the dataset

```{r}
data_cell_lines <- read_csv(here(
  data_dir,
  "RNAseq_raw_counts_celllines.csv"
))

metadata <- read_csv(here(
  "manuscript", paste0("Figure1_", datestamp),
  "Figure1BC.csv"
)) |>
  dplyr::rename(group = group.y)

setdiff(colnames(data_cell_lines), metadata$group)
setdiff(metadata$group, colnames(data_cell_lines))

metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(group %in% colnames(data_cell_lines))

dim(data_cell_lines)
dim(metadata)
```

#### 1. Filter on gene expression (CPM \>= 1 in n\>=5)

Prepare data: keep only genes that have more than 1 cpm in at least 5 cell lines. Amount of million reads per sample is:

```{r}
data_cell_lines |>
  dplyr::select(-EnsemblID) |>
  colSums() |>
  lapply(function(x) round(x / 1E6, 1)) |>
  unlist() |>
  sort()
```

So let's say at least 10 counts.

-   have count \> 10 in 5 or more cell lines,
-   have a mean count more than 1.

```{r}
dim(data_cell_lines)
data_cell_lines <- column_to_rownames(data_cell_lines, "EnsemblID") |>
  filter(rowSums(across(everything(), ~ .x > 10)) >= 5) |>
  filter(rowMeans(across(everything(), ~.x)) > 1)
dim(data_cell_lines)
```

#### 2. Differential gene expression analysis

```{r}
metadata <- metadata |>
  dplyr::select(group, Factor1, Subtype_4_categories, ProliferationRate) |>
  filter(group %in% colnames(data_cell_lines)) |>
  dplyr::rename(Subtype = Subtype_4_categories) |>
  mutate(Subtype = factor(Subtype, levels = c("Luminal", "HER2pos", "BasalA", "BasalB")))
dim(metadata)
head(metadata)

table(metadata$Subtype)
```

```{r}
## order of the metadata file has to be the same as the count file. Check if this is true:
identical(metadata$group, colnames(data_cell_lines))

# Change the order
data_cell_lines <- dplyr::select(data_cell_lines, all_of(metadata$group))
stopifnot(identical(metadata$group, colnames(data_cell_lines)))

data_cell_lines[1:5, 1:5]
```

```{r}
dim(data_cell_lines)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = data_cell_lines,
  colData = metadata,
  design = ~Factor1
)
dds <- DESeq(dds)

print(resultsNames(dds))

get_DEGs <- function(res, ID_name = "EnsemblID") {
  # Get results summary
  print(str_glue("Nr of padj < 0.1  = {sum(res$padj < 0.1,  na.rm=TRUE)}"))
  print(str_glue("Nr of padj < 0.05 = {sum(res$padj < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE)}"))
  print(str_glue("Nr of padj < 0.01 = {sum(res$padj < 0.01, na.rm=TRUE)}"))

  DEGs <- res |>
    data.frame() |>
    arrange(padj) |>
    rownames_to_column(ID_name) |>
    left_join(
      dplyr::select(gene_identifier_table, EnsemblID, NCBI_Gene_ID, gene_symbol),
      by = ID_name
    )
  return(DEGs)
}

res <- results(dds)
DEGs_Factor1 <- get_DEGs(res)
dim(DEGs_Factor1)
head(DEGs_Factor1)

filter(DEGs_Factor1, padj < 0.1) |> nrow()
filter(DEGs_Factor1, padj < 0.1, abs(log2FoldChange) > 0) |> nrow()
filter(DEGs_Factor1, padj < 0.1, log2FoldChange > 0) |> nrow()

write_csv(DEGs_Factor1, here(output_dir, "DEGs_Factor1.csv"))
```

```{r}
dim(data_cell_lines)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = data_cell_lines,
  colData = metadata,
  design = ~Subtype
)
dds <- DESeq(dds)

print(resultsNames(dds))

# Get results and results summary
res <- results(dds, name = "Subtype_BasalB_vs_Luminal")

DEGs_Subtype <- get_DEGs(res)
dim(DEGs_Subtype)
head(DEGs_Subtype)

filter(DEGs_Subtype, padj < 0.1) |> nrow()
filter(DEGs_Subtype, padj < 0.1, abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1) |> nrow()
filter(DEGs_Subtype, padj < 0.1, log2FoldChange >= 1) |> nrow()

write_csv(DEGs_Subtype, here(output_dir, "DEGs_Subtype.csv"))
```

```{r}
DEGs <- inner_join(
  DEGs_Factor1 |>
    dplyr::select(-lfcSE, -stat, -pvalue),
  DEGs_Subtype |>
    dplyr::select(-lfcSE, -stat, -pvalue),
  by = c("EnsemblID", "NCBI_Gene_ID", "gene_symbol"),
  suffix = c("_Factor1", "_Subtype")
) |>
  relocate(c("EnsemblID", "NCBI_Gene_ID", "gene_symbol"))
head(DEGs)
```

#### 3. Filter on metabolic genes

Keep genes if they are in the metabolic gene list and have a FDR \< 0.1 in either analysis, together with an effect size of log2 FC \> 0.5 for basal B:luminal, or coefficient \> 0 for association with factor 1.

```{r}
DEGs <- DEGs |>
  mutate(is_metabolic = ifelse(NCBI_Gene_ID %in% metabolic_genes$NCBI_Gene_ID, TRUE, FALSE))

metabolic_DEGs <- DEGs |>
  filter(is_metabolic == TRUE)
dim(metabolic_DEGs)
head(metabolic_DEGs)

print(str_glue("expressed metabolic genes is: {nrow(metabolic_DEGs)}"))
filter(metabolic_DEGs, padj_Factor1 < 0.1) |> nrow()
filter(metabolic_DEGs, padj_Subtype < 0.1) |> nrow()
filter(metabolic_DEGs, padj_Factor1 < 0.1, abs(log2FoldChange_Factor1) > 1) |> nrow()
filter(metabolic_DEGs, padj_Subtype < 0.1, abs(log2FoldChange_Subtype) > 1) |> nrow()

filter(metabolic_DEGs, padj_Factor1 < 0.1, log2FoldChange_Factor1 > 0) |> nrow()
filter(metabolic_DEGs, padj_Subtype < 0.1, log2FoldChange_Subtype > 1) |> nrow()

# overlap between the two analyses
intersect(
  filter(metabolic_DEGs, padj_Factor1 < 0.1, log2FoldChange_Factor1 > 0) |> pull(gene_symbol),
  filter(metabolic_DEGs, padj_Subtype < 0.1, log2FoldChange_Subtype > 1) |> pull(gene_symbol)
) |>
  length()

# differences between the two analyses
setdiff(
  filter(metabolic_DEGs, padj_Factor1 < 0.1, log2FoldChange_Factor1 > 0) |> pull(gene_symbol),
  filter(metabolic_DEGs, padj_Subtype < 0.1, log2FoldChange_Subtype > 1) |> pull(gene_symbol)
) |>
  length()
setdiff(
  filter(metabolic_DEGs, padj_Subtype < 0.1, log2FoldChange_Factor1 > 1) |> pull(gene_symbol),
  filter(metabolic_DEGs, padj_Factor1 < 0.1, log2FoldChange_Subtype > 0) |> pull(gene_symbol)
) |>
  length()
# Keep only genes with either
DEGs <- DEGs |>
  mutate(is_metabolic_DEG = (is_metabolic & (
    (padj_Factor1 < 0.1 & log2FoldChange_Factor1 > 0) |
      (padj_Subtype < 0.1 & log2FoldChange_Subtype > 1)
  )
  ))

metabolic_DEGs <- filter(DEGs, is_metabolic_DEG == TRUE)
nrow(metabolic_DEGs)

write_csv(metabolic_DEGs, here(output_dir, "metabolic_DEGs.csv"))
```

#### 4. Filter on patient expression

```{r}
# Patient tissue
patient_RNAseq <- read_tsv(here(
  "data", "brca_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018",

normal_RNAseq[1:5, 1:5]

#### Combine
data_for_DESeq2 <- inner_join(
  patient_RNAseq |> dplyr::select(-Hugo_Symbol),
  normal_RNAseq |> dplyr::select(-Hugo_Symbol),
  by = "Entrez_Gene_Id"
) |>
  column_to_rownames("Entrez_Gene_Id")
dim(data_for_DESeq2)
data_for_DESeq2[1:5, 1:5]

#### Metadata
metadata_for_DESeq <- read_tsv(
  here(
    "data", "brca_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018",
    "data_clinical_patient.txt"
  ),
  comment = "#"
) |>
  # remove all male
  filter(SEX != "MALE") |>
  # Remove all without defined subtype
  filter(!is.na(SUBTYPE)) |>
  mutate(
    normal = str_c(PATIENT_ID, "-11"),
    patient = str_c(PATIENT_ID, "-01")
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(normal, patient, SUBTYPE) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(normal, patient),
    names_to = "design_group", values_to = "patient_ID"
  ) |>
  mutate(SUBTYPE = ifelse(design_group == "normal", "normal tissue", SUBTYPE))
dim(metadata_for_DESeq)
head(metadata_for_DESeq)
tail(metadata_for_DESeq)

# keep only samples also in the RNA seq data
metadata_for_DESeq <- left_join(
  data.frame("patient_ID" = colnames(data_for_DESeq2)),
  metadata_for_DESeq,
  by = "patient_ID"
) |>
  column_to_rownames("patient_ID")
dim(metadata_for_DESeq)

# Check columns and order
stopifnot(nrow(metadata_for_DESeq) == ncol(data_for_DESeq2))
stopifnot(all(rownames(metadata_for_DESeq) == colnames(data_for_DESeq2)))
```

Count the number of patients with a subtype

```{r}
metadata_for_DESeq |>
  group_by(SUBTYPE, design_group) |>
  summarize(n = n()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = SUBTYPE, names_from = design_group, values_from = n)
```

#### 5. Include information on metabolite subsystems

Using the full Reactome list, because these can be at higher levels in the hierarchy of Reactome than previously used pathways.

-   Synthesis of DNA: R-HSA-69239
-   Proteasome: R-HSA-68819
-   Collagen formation: R-HSA-1474290

```{r}
  "R-HSA-68819", # Proteasome
  "R-HSA-69239", # Synthesis of DNA
  "R-HSA-1428517", # The citric acid (TCA) cycle and respiratory electron transport,
  "R-HSA-382551" # Transport of small molecules
)

Reactome_selection <- Ensembl2Reactome_All_Levels |>
  filter(Reactome_ID %in% processes_of_interest)

# Also get a vector with Reactome pathway names, or stop if pathways are missing
if (length(setdiff(processes_of_interest, unique(Reactome_selection$Reactome_ID))) == 0) {
  processes_of_interest <- dplyr::select(Reactome_selection, Reactome_ID, Event_Name) |>
    distinct()
} else {
  stop()
}

table(Reactome_selection$Event_Name)
head(Reactome_selection)

Reactome_selection <- Reactome_selection |>
  dplyr::select(Source_ID, Event_Name) |>
  distinct() |>
  mutate(value = 1) |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = Source_ID, names_from = Event_Name,
    values_from = value, values_fill = 0
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(EnsemblID = Source_ID)

metabolic_targets <- metabolic_targets |>
  left_join(Reactome_selection,
    by = "EnsemblID"
  ) |>
  mutate(across(colnames(Reactome_selection), ~ replace_na(., 0)))

dim(metabolic_targets)
head(metabolic_targets)

metabolic_targets <- metabolic_targets |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(in_pathway = sum(across(all_of(processes_of_interest$Event_Name))))
```

#### 6. Select genes for a screen

We chose this manually to represent multiple metabolic processes.

```{r}
selection <- c(
  "NUDT5", "PTDSS1", "PTGES2", "PTGES2", "COQ3", "DLAT", "DPAGT1",
  "GCDH", "GCDH", "BCAT1", "AKR1B1", "PIK3CD", "GSTP1", "AGPAT4", "SLC7A11", "UPP1",
  "CHST3", "LDHB", "ADCY7", "SMOX", "HACD1", "HPSE", "B3GNT5", "SLC16A3", "MOCOS",
  "EXT1", "ABCC4", "ODC1", "PSAT1", "TYMS", "TYMS", "GLS", "GALNT2", "FADS1",
  "SOAT1", "GSTO1", "MTMR2", "SLC7A1", "MTHFD1L", "ADA", "TRDMT1", "TRDMT1",
  "PLOD2", "PLOD2", "HPRT1", "ALDH1B1", "HMOX1", "LDHA", "LDHA", "LDHA", "TXNRD1",
  "SLC20A1", "CTPS1", "EXTL3", "CPOX", "PHGDH", "PFKP", "ADI1", "LBR", "GCLM",
  "MGAT2", "AGPAT5", "SLC2A6", "FXN", "FXN", "NAMPT", "NAMPT", "ATP1B3", "POFUT1",
  "EXT2", "CERK", "CERK", "CHSY1", "AMPD2", "DGUOK", "HMBS", "CHST14", "PTS", "NME7",
  "ENO1", "ENO1", "GART", "UAP1", "B4GALT5", "DTYMK", "AASDHPPT", "PSPH", "ARSB", "RPIA"
)

setdiff(selection, metabolic_DEGs$gene_symbol)
old_selection <- setdiff(selection, metabolic_targets$gene_symbol)
old_selection

intersect(selection, metabolic_targets$gene_symbol) |>
  length()

metabolic_targets <- metabolic_targets |>
  mutate(
    selection_siRNA = ifelse(gene_symbol %in% selection, "selected", "not selected")
  ) |>
  relocate(selection_siRNA, .after = "padj_Subtype")

DEGs <- DEGs |>
  mutate(selection_siRNA = ((gene_symbol %in% selection) & is_metabolic_target))

write_csv(metabolic_targets, here(output_dir, "metabolic_targets.csv"))
write_csv(DEGs, here(output_dir, "DEGs.csv"))
```
